skill_concept: Configure, patch, and compile C/C++ or system-level software from source using make/cmake/gcc, resolving toolchain errors, missing dependencies, and platform-specific build issues.
verdict_reason: Most tasks share a core build-from-source procedure (fetch source, patch for platform compatibility, configure, compile, install) and would benefit from the candidate skill, but caffe-cifar-10 extends well beyond building into ML training orchestration, dataset preparation, and numerical validation, while build-tcc-qemu and build-linux-kernel-qemu add QEMU/kernel-specific steps that deviate substantially from a generic C/C++ build procedure.
weakest_link_reason: This task requires not just building Caffe from source but also downloading and preprocessing CIFAR-10 data, running training for a precise iteration count, capturing output, and validating accuracy thresholds — most of the work is ML workflow, not toolchain compilation.
